entities.name: Filip Novák
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Filip Novák is a Czech former professional ice hockey player. Novak last played for Traktor Chelyabinsk in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He has won the Gagarin Cup twice with Dynamo Moscow in 2012 and 2013.
